newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt, Aruba airports sign co-operation deal.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt, Aruba airports sign co-operation deal.

text.p: Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG), the owner and manager of Frankfurt airport, has signed an official co-operation agreement with Aruba airport in the Netherlands Antilles.
The agreement covers the exchange of information, joint marketing activities and joint airport consultancy in the Caribbean, FAG said.
FAG consultancy subsidiary Airconsult helped plan the expansion of Aruba airport in the 1970s, FAG noted.
Since then, Aruba airport staff have been trained in Frankfurt and two FAG staff currently advise Aruba airport management, it added.
